Sam: Heads-up from Harmonia7 - they want a short POC to validate a new "Harmony-Llama-13B" variant. Asks: custom tokenizer, 4-bit quant, KV-cache compatibility, and committed per-call pricing for a 6-week trial.
Leila: Cool. Do we have a catalog entry? I see harmony-llama-13b-v0 in staging but no tokenizer artifacts. Ask them for tokenizer.json + merges and a 2-3 file sample corpus.
Diego: On quant + kv-cache: our 4-bit path supports it but we7ve observed token alignment issues when special token indices shift. If their tokenizer inserts new special tokens we need to remap or run a tokenizer-stitch preproc.
Ava: Security asks: KMS + VPC + SOC2. We can provide SOC2 report and optional private deploy; for KMS need their key policy for cross-account setup. Also confirm retention window for logs.
Sam: I'll request tokenizer files and sample logs. Diego, can you run a quick perf on the 4-bit variant (seq=1024, batch=6) and compare to fp16 baseline? Need p50/p95.
Diego: Running now. snippet:
```bash
redwood perf --model harmony-llama-13b-v0 --quant 4bit --seq 1024 --batch 6
# p50: 54ms/token
# p95: 220ms/token
redwood perf --model harmony-llama-13b-v0 --quant fp16 --seq 1024 --batch 6
# p50: 48ms/token
# p95: 180ms/token
```
Diego: Notes: 4-bit adds modest tail; enable prefix caching for chat to reduce cost and p95. Also adding a token remap layer shaved off a few ms in our harness. Logs: https://redwood.internal/tickets/11234
Leila: Pricing estimate: hosted pay-as-you-go ~ $0.009 / 1k tokens; small dedicated pool w/ commitment ~ $2.5k/mo. For a 6-week POC we can offer a temporary committed discount + 20k free-burst tokens. Will draft options.
Sam: Great. Also document fallback: float16 variant auto-fallback if p95 breaches SLA. Include runbook steps for common tokenization fixes (strip BPE merges, normalize unk tokens).
Ava: Enterprise note: if they want log retention >90 days we need enterprise addendum + updated SLA. Also confirm whether model input includes PHI. If yes, recommend private deployment.
Sam: Proposed POC timeline: week 0: artifacts + security QS; week 1: tokenization validation; week 2: perf + cost modeling; week 3-4: integration and ops runbook; week 5-6: handoff + decision. I will send POC plan and security QS now.
Leila: I'll attach the pricing sheet and a quick checklist for tokenizer artifacts.
Diego: I'll prepare the small adapter snippet to remap special tokens and paste in the ticket.
redwood-ci: Ticket created: RW-11234 assigned to #sales and #eng-ml.
Sam: Thanks all, will update after customer sends artifacts :thumbsup:
